reason: Value and transfer lens. The idea fails the +0.002 bar by its own numbers, and the recomputation is lower still. (0) OWN ESTIMATE. The idea claims 0 on its own and +0.001..+0.002 marginal on top of ideas 1/2. Both of those were refuted on value with central estimates of -0.001 and -0.002 (v_external-data-training_dense-dorado-secondary_value.json, v_external-data-training_dense-primary-headrefit_value.json). A feeder adds nothing when the consumer is negative. (1) CEILING. One FN->TP is worth 1/135,729 = 7.37e-6 J in the lab. The 6bba detector-addressable FN are a_never 1,740 + b_swap 1,731 = 3,471 (fn_anatomy_exp39.md), a hard cap of +0.0256, and that cap is in-sample. The a_never nodes are ANNOTATED 6bba GT nodes that the public detector was already trained on as positives and still misses. So the misses come from ambiguity and resolution between touching nuclei, not from missing labels. Dense labels add positives only for the unannotated neighbours. (2) THE TEACHER IS WEAKER THAN THE STUDENT ON THE HARD CASES. The hosts' own Ultrack run (UNet boundaries, full volume, then proofread into GT) covers GT at 97.2% <=7 um and 91.7% <4 um. Our final nodes already match GT at 0.988 <=7 um on 44b6 (research/wf_ideas_v2/r2_critic.notes.md:15,20). The proposed teacher is weaker still: classical detect_foreground + robust_invert on 64x256x256 crops, with crop-border effects, a config tuned for a full-embryo postgres run (config.toml verified), and min/max_area in unknown voxel units. Classical boundaries under-segment exactly the dense 6bba tissue where the a_never FN sit. The quality gate in the idea (>=95% of GT within 7 um) would pass a teacher that is WORSE than the current detector (98.3-98.8%), so it does not measure value. The only complementary signal on record is that hosts' Ultrack points cover ~83% of our misses (union 0.988->0.998), but at +30-40% nodes. Those points are the over-segmentation a detector would learn, and each +1% N_pred costs ~0.0009. The 6bba lab node ratio is already -0.021 (near N_est). A pseudo set at ~1.10 N_est pushes 6bba above N_est. Threshold recalibration on in-sample videos leaves +-2-3% (= +-0.002-0.003) on unseen embryos, because fine-tune node drift changed sign across embryos (+3.2/+5.6/-6.6%). (3) TRANSFER. Every gain is measured on 6bba, which is in-sample for the public detector and edge net AND for the new dense labels. That is the known lab artefact of +0.01..+0.016 locally and 0 on the LB (#29, #30). The binding constraint on unseen embryos is embryo shift, not label density: the 6bba-only scratch model scores 0.8332 on its own videos but 0.6803 LOEO on 44b6 (RESULTS.md, friend A exp02). The only controlled external dense-label detector result is negative: -0.0033 head-only and -0.0377 head+encoder (discussions_summary.md:216). All 4 secondary swaps and 3 primary swaps on our LB were negative (-0.002..-0.025). Classical-Ultrack centroids also add a third localisation convention (6bba GT z offset +0.82 um vs 44b6 +0.18 um already sank the head retrain). The swap FN class is position-driven (4.4 vs 1.8 um), so a convention shift can hurt. (4) RECOMPUTED EXPECTATION. In-sample, 15-25% of the 3,471 fixed (guess) = +0.004..+0.006 lab. Times the marginal share over dorado-only (~0.5, guess) and transfer 0.2-0.3, that gives +0.0005..+0.001. Minus P(harm ~0.4) x 0.004 from node drift and perturbation = central about -0.001 public, below the +0.002 bar and far inside the 0.003 LB noise (byte-identical notebooks 0.946/0.942). A single probe cannot resolve it.
fix_if_any: Not as an LB item before 29 Sep. The honest repaired version is an information-isolating, unseen-embryo A/B that the team can partly run with existing assets. (a) CPU pre-kill, run before any GPU (friend A/C lab caches, no images needed beyond the pilot): pilot Ultrack on the 20 densest 6bba videos. Kill unless (i) >= 40% of the exp39 a_never GT nodes in those videos have a pseudo point within 3 um, (ii) >= 60% of pseudo points lie within 4 um of an existing prediction (else it is over-segmentation noise), and (iii) pseudo count/N_est <= 1.10. A 7-um recall gate against annotated GT is meaningless when the student is already at 0.983-0.988. (b) Honest transfer test: start from friend A's 6bba-only scratch model (friend_a_exp02_loeo20, never saw 44b6). Arm A = fine-tune on 6bba sparse + 6bba Ultrack dense; arm B = the same steps, lr and sampling on 6bba sparse only. Score both LOEO on the 12 honest 44b6 videos with the official metric at matched N_pred (+-1%). Gate: A - B >= +0.008 for 2 seeds (seed noise +-0.005, RESULTS.md exp16), >= 8/12 videos non-negative, a_never FN down >= 15%. That is ~2-3 h on the 5070 Ti per arm-seed plus 0.7 h eval, i.e. 8-12 h of friend A GPU. (c) Only if (b) passes, feed the pseudo set into idea 1/2's secondary fine-tune and submit one paired probe with promotion at >= base + 0.004. Realistically (b) + (c) do not fit before 29 Sep 10:00 UTC. Treat this as post-deadline research, or as a pre-kill only.
realistic_public_gain: about -0.001 central (range -0.008..+0.003). The marginal value as a feeder to ideas 1/2 is ~+0.0005..+0.001 before harm, and the idea's own claim of +0.001..+0.002 is already below the +0.002 bar. Harm: node drift from over-segmented pseudo-labels (+-2-3% N_pred = +-0.002-0.003), plus the 7/7 negative record of detector swaps on our LB. P(>= +0.005) ~3-5%.
realistic_private_gain: about -0.001 central (range -0.010..+0.003, guess). Private is ~71% unseen embryos. Embryo shift (0.83 in-sample vs 0.68 LOEO for a single-embryo model) dominates density effects. The classical-Ultrack localisation convention differs from both train embryos' annotation conventions, and node drift after fine-tunes changes sign across embryos, so a public-calibrated threshold cannot control it privately.
